verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a marketing-automation platform, since self-hostable alternatives exist in this category, so the axis applies. Klaviyo's evidence describes only a hosted SaaS: account plans on klaviyo.com, cloud APIs, SDKs and headless API/MCP access. The option to run the MCP server locally is an integration connector, not the core product, so nothing shows the core platform can be self-hosted.
